preview.subject: HANGS Construction Services October 2026 close records
preview.body:
Hello,

Attached are the October 2026 billing register, purchases register and general ledger export for HANGS Construction Services LLC. The job list, the reseller permits on file and the invoice for change order 7 on Pier 9 Tech Center are in the shared folder.

Please note the October trial balance has not been approved yet. Treat the ledger as unapproved until I confirm.

The only reseller permit we hold for October subcontract work is Cedar Ridge Builders. We have asked Summit Line Construction for theirs.

Please prepare the October combined excise return as a draft for review. We file it ourselves in My DOR once it is reviewed.

Dana Whitfield
Controller, HANGS Construction Services

messages.subject: HANGS Construction Services October 2026 close records
messages.body:
Hello,

Attached are the October 2026 billing register, purchases register and general ledger export for HANGS Construction Services LLC. The job list, the reseller permits on file and the invoice for change order 7 on Pier 9 Tech Center are in the shared folder.

Please note the October trial balance has not been approved yet. Treat the ledger as unapproved until I confirm.

The only reseller permit we hold for October subcontract work is Cedar Ridge Builders. We have asked Summit Line Construction for theirs.

Please prepare the October combined excise return as a draft for review. We file it ourselves in My DOR once it is reviewed.

Dana Whitfield
Controller, HANGS Construction Services

passages.q: What B&O rates apply to retailing and wholesaling?
Which classification does each job's billing belong to?
passages.a: The income from custom prime contracting (without deduction for any amounts paid to subcontractors) is reported under the retailing B&O tax classification and is subject to retail sales tax unless a specific exemption applies.

passages.q: Is retainage held by the owner deducted before B&O and sales tax?
passages.a: If the contract requires retainage, sales tax must be computed before deducting such amounts. ... On the excise tax return, report the full selling price without a deduction for retainage under the Retailing B&O tax classification and retail sales tax.

passages.q: Which location code and rate apply to retail construction billings?
passages.a: Retail construction services are sourced to the location where the construction takes place. This means construction that takes place in Seattle is sourced to Seattle (location code 1726) and taxed at Seattle's combined state and local sales tax rate.

passages.q: HGC-26-1043 charged the owner Bellevue's 10.30% instead of Seattle's 10.55%. Should the owner be rebilled?
passages.a: Billing invoices must separately state the sales tax. ... Progress billings made against the total contract price of a job should separately state the sales tax.

passages.q: When is the October 2026 monthly return due, and when do late penalties begin?
passages.a: October 2026 Return due date: 11/25/26 9% penalty begins: 11/26/26 19% penalty begins: 01/01/27 29% penalty begins: 02/02/27

passages.q: Is a monthly return the right frequency for this business?
passages.a: Monthly returns are due the 25th of every month. (e.g. the June tax return is due July 25.)

sources.title: Quarter 4 2026 Local Sales and Use Tax Rates

passages.q: What are the Q4 2026 local and combined rates for Bellevue, Seattle and Tacoma?

sources.title: Combined Excise Tax Return: Local City and/or County Sales and Use Tax

passages.q: How are local sales and use taxes entered, and what must they agree with?
passages.a: Write the location codes and rates in the appropriate columns for each location where retail sales took place. ... This amount must be the same as your taxable amount for retail sales in column 3.

sources.title: Combined Excise Tax Return: State Sales and Use Tax

passages.q: What goes on the state retail sales tax line?
passages.a: This amount must be the same as the gross amount for retailing in your business and occupation tax section. ... Multiply the taxable amount by the tax rate shown (0.065) and write this amount in tax due.

passages.q: Which October purchases owe use tax?
passages.a: Use tax applies to the value of all articles you used in your business (as opposed to being sold to a customer) on which no Washington sales tax has been paid.

passages.q: Which local rate applies to use tax, and in which period is it reported?
passages.a: The use tax rate is determined by the location in Washington where the consumer (customer) first uses the items purchased. Use tax is made of the state rate (6.5%) plus the local use tax rate.

passages.q: Can HGC-26-1048 to Summit Line Construction be reported as wholesale without a reseller permit on file?
passages.a: A subcontractor entering into a construction contract for which it has not received a reseller permit must obtain it within one hundred twenty days of the initial construction draw request.

sources.title: WAC 458-20-170, Constructing and repairing of new or existing buildings or other structures upon real property

passages.q: What is the measure of B&O and retail sales tax on a construction contract?
passages.a: (a) Prime contractors are taxable under the retailing classification, and subcontractors under the wholesaling classification upon the gross contract price. ... (a) Prime contractors are required to collect from consumers the retail sales tax measured by the full contract price.

passages.q: Is the Juniper Ridge work for Juniper Ridge Partners LLC, with no reseller permit or exemption certificate on file, a retail sale?
passages.a: (a) The term "prime contractor" means a person engaged in the business of performing for consumers, the constructing, repairing, decorating or improving of new or existing buildings or other structures under, upon or above real property ... (b) The word "subcontractor" means a person engaged in the business of performing a similar service for persons other than consumers.

checks.title: Invoice HGC-26-1043: register vs PDF amount billed
Invoice HGC-26-1043: register vs PDF sales tax
Local taxable vs state retail taxable
A difference is an open item for a person. No balancing entry is posted.
LOC-01
checks.detail: Invoice HGC-26-1043 (Pier 9 Tech Center, 166 office suites) charged 10.30% for Bellevue (1704), but the job site is Seattle (1726) at 10.55%. The return reports the job-site rate: $113,600.00 x 10.55% = $11,984.80, against $11,700.80 charged. $284.00 was not collected from the owner. A person decides whether to rebill; no plug posted.

checks.title: RESALE-01
checks.detail: No reseller permit on file from Summit Line Construction Co. for invoice HGC-26-1048 ($240,000.00). The job list shows the first billing on October 30, 2026, so the permit can still be obtained by February 27, 2027 (120 days, WAC 458-20-102). The draft keeps it in wholesaling. Until the permit arrives a person decides; if it never arrives, retail sales tax of $25,320.00 would be due. No plug posted.

checks.title: DOC-01
checks.detail: The October trial balance is unapproved. The client's email of 02 Nov 2026 says it has not been approved yet. The draft uses the supplied general ledger and registers; its figures change only when an approved export is supplied.

checks.title: RETURN-01
checks.detail: This is an unsigned draft in the return's sections, not the Department's form. A person reviews it, decides the open items and the retail treatment of Juniper Ridge Business Park, 9 flex buildings, with no reseller permit or exemption certificate on file, and files and pays in My DOR by November 25, 2026. Nothing has been filed or paid.
